aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.description: The aspect ratio of the generated video

camera_motion.title: Camera Motion
camera_motion.description: Optional camera motion applied to the generated video.

generate_audio.title: Generate Audio
generate_audio.description: Whether to generate audio for the generated video

fps.title: Frames per Second
fps.description: The frames per second of the generated video.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: The duration of the generated video in seconds. At 720p and 1080p, 24 or 25 FPS supports up to 20 seconds, while 48 or 50 FPS supports up to 10 seconds. At 1440p and 2160p, all frame rates support up to 10 seconds. Set to 'auto' to let the model choose the duration automatically.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: The prompt to use for the generated video

resolution.title: Resolution
resolution.description: The resolution of the generated video.

num_frames.title: Num Frames
num_frames.description: The number of frames in the video

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.

file_size.title: File Size
file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
